Introduction

Ugly Duck is a rapper, singer, songwriter, MC & DJ under Jay Park's label AOMG since 2014. He debuted under AOMG with the collaboration album "Scene Stealers" with Jay Park, on July 13, 2016. He was discovered by rapper Simon Dominic.

Ugly Duck is currently playing as a DJ worldwide under the crew name of BACK&FORTH with DJ Pumkin and DJ Wegun. Ugly Duck is now reinforcing his irreplaceable position in the hip-hop scene as an artist who can’t be simply defined as an MC or DJ.
